gb.title: The Breakdown | Rattled All Blacks face rare twin threat as England eye back-to-back scalps
gb.description: After their seismic defeat by Wales, New Zealand face the prospect of history repeating itself in unwanted ways They still talk about the last – and only – time the All Blacks have contrived to lose twice in succession to England. Back in 2002-03, as now, there was a Rugby World Cup looming in Australia and New Zealand had no shortage of quality players. “There is so much talent in New Zealand that, if they don’t win the World Cup, there should be an inquiry,” opined Steve Hansen, Wales’s head coach at the time, ahead of England’s fateful visit to Wellington in the summer of 2003. There’s a fresh inquiry under way now even before the All Blacks trot out of the Twickenham tunnel this weekend for the 48th meeting between the two nations. While Saturday’s 35-28 defeat to Wales ended a 73-year wait from a home perspective it has inevitably precipitated plenty of dark muttering back in the land of the long flat white. Op Terschelling is de stellingmolen van Formerum een blikvanger en een attractie. Bij een stellingmolen komen de wieken tot aan de stelling en niet tot op de grond. De molen dateert uit 1838 en verhuisde in 1876 naar zijn huidige plek. Hij is in privébezit en wordt goed onderhouden. Er zit een koffiebar in, en op verschillende dagen laat de molenaar de wieken draaien. Daarvoor moeten eerst de zeilen op de wieken worden gespannen. Texel en Ameland Op Texel staat bij Oosterend molen Het Noorden, die nog echt werkt. Deze poldermolen uit 1878 maalt het water uit de gelijknamige polder. De molen is eigendom van Natuurmonumenten, dat hem ook openstelt voor publiek. De andere Texelse molen is een grotere stellingmolen en hoort bij museum Kaap Skil in Oudeschild.

gr.title: Οι ψυχολόγοι συμφωνούν: Όσοι καταγράφουν τις υποχρεώσεις τους σε ημερολόγιο αντί στο κινητό επεξεργάζονται πληροφορίες με διαφορετικό τρόπο
gr.description: Οι ψυχολόγοι εξηγούν πώς η καταγραφή των υποχρεώσεων σε χάρτινο ημερολόγιο, αντί στο κινητό, επηρεάζει τον τρόπο με τον οποίο λειτουργεί ο εγκέφαλος, ενισχύει τη μνήμη και τη διάθεση για δράση και διαμορφώνει τον τρόπο που οργανώνουμε τη ζωή μας. Για κάποιους, το παραδοσιακό ημερολόγιο μοιάζει ξεπερασμένο. Για τους ψυχολόγους, ωστόσο, αποτελεί ένδειξη ενός διαφορετικού τρόπου σκέψης και λειτουργίας του εγκεφάλου. Έρευνες δείχνουν ότι όσοι καταγράφουν τις υποχρεώσεις τους σε χαρτί, αντί να βασίζονται αποκλειστικά στο κινητό, δεν το κάνουν απλώς από συνήθεια ή νοσταλγία. Αυτός ο τρόπος οργάνωσης ενεργοποιεί διαφορετικές λειτουργίες του εγκεφάλου, επηρεάζοντας τη μνήμη και την ικανότητα προγραμματισμού. Ο εγκέφαλος θυμάται διαφορετικά όσα γράφονται στο χαρτί Μελέτες που συγκρίνουν τη χρήση χαρτιού και ηλεκτρονικών συσκευών δείχνουν ότι όταν γράφουμε με το χέρι, ενεργοποιούνται περισσότερο περιοχές του εγκεφάλου που σχετίζονται με τη μνήμη, την οπτική αντίληψη και τη επεξεργασία του λόγου. Ειδικότερα, έρευνα του Πανεπιστημίου του Τόκιο, το 2021, έδειξε ότι όσοι χρησιμοποιούσαν χάρτινα ημερολόγια μπορούσαν να ανακαλέσουν πληροφορίες περίπου 25% ταχύτερα σε σύγκριση με όσους χρησιμοποιούσαν smartphones. Η επαφή με το χαρτί, η κίνηση του χεριού κατά τη γραφή και η οπτική εικόνα των σημειώσεων φαίνεται να βοηθούν τον εγκέφαλο να συγκρατεί καλύτερα τις πληροφορίες. Στο ίδιο συμπέρασμα συνηγορούν και έρευνες των νευροεπιστημόνων Ruud Van der Weel και Audrey Van der Meer, οι οποίοι, χρησιμοποιώντας ηλεκτροεγκεφαλογράφημα (EEG), διαπίστωσαν ότι η χειρόγραφη γραφή ενεργοποιεί περισσότερες και ευρύτερες περιοχές του εγκεφάλου σε σχέση με την πληκτρολόγηση. Λιγότερες ειδοποιήσεις, περισσότερη ενεργή μνήμη Με το ψηφιακό ημερολόγιο αφήνουμε ουσιαστικά το κινητό να θυμάται για εμάς. Καταχωρίζουμε ένα ραντεβού και περιμένουμε την ειδοποίηση για να το θυμηθούμε. Αντίθετα, το χάρτινο ημερολόγιο μάς παρακινεί να συγκρατούμε τις πληροφορίες, καθώς χρειάζεται να ανατρέχουμε συχνά σε όσα έχουμε σημειώσει. Αυτή η διαδικασία εξασκεί τη μνήμη μας και ενισχύει την ικανότητά μας να θυμόμαστε τις υποχρεώσεις και τις δραστηριότητες που έχουμε προγραμματίσει για το μέλλον, χωρίς να εξαρτόμαστε από ψηφιακές υπενθυμίσεις. Η καλύτερη λύση είναι ο συνδυασμός Έρευνες δείχνουν ότι η καταγραφή των στόχων και η τακτική αξιολόγηση της προόδου μας συμβάλλουν στην αποτελεσματικότερη επίτευξή τους. Αυτό δεν σημαίνει, βέβαια, ότι πρέπει να εγκαταλείψουμε το κινητό μας. Μπορούμε να αξιοποιούμε το ψηφιακό ημερολόγιο για τα ραντεβού, τις ειδοποιήσεις, τα ταξίδια και τις κοινές οικογενειακές υποχρεώσεις, κρατώντας το χάρτινο για τον εβδομαδιαίο προγραμματισμό, τις προσωπικές μας προτεραιότητες και τους στόχους που θέλουμε να πετύχουμε. Τελικά, η καταγραφή των υποχρεώσεων στο χαρτί δεν αποτελεί απλώς μια νοσταλγική συνήθεια. Είναι ένας διαφορετικός τρόπος να οργανώνουμε τον χρόνο μας, να συγκρατούμε όσα έχουν σημασία και να παραμένουμε προσηλωμένοι σε όσα θέλουμε να πετύχουμε. sg.title: Tencent Launches Hy4 flash to Power High-Speed, Cost-Efficient AI Deployment for Everyday Workflows
sg.description: SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tencent today announced the release of Hy4 flash, the latest addition to its Hy model family. Hy4 flash has 224 billion total parameters (including 64 billion Engram parameters) with only 12 billion active parameters, and supports multimodal inputs and a context length of up to 1M tokens. It is the most cost-effective Hy model to date, priced at approximately US$0.070 per million input tokens, US$0.281 per million output tokens, and US$0.003 per million cached input tokens — a substantial reduction from Hy4. Tencent To achieve this level of cost performance while maintaining strong intelligence and practical utility, the Tencent Hy team made a series of engineering choices across the model pipeline: Pre-training: Hy4 flash incorporates hybrid attention, LatentMoE, and Engram architectural features. The KV cache size is just 1/24 that of Hy3 and 1/6 that of Hy4. Extensive scaling ladder experiments were conducted to ensure performance met expectations. Post-training: Drawing directly from Hy4's architecture, the model inherits strong general intelligence. Reinforcement learning cuts average end-to-end task output tokens by 50 percent. Evaluation: The team built WorkIndex, an internal benchmark based on typical WorkBuddy tasks, paired with human evaluations, focusing on deliverable quality, single-turn output length, and task turnaround time rather than public benchmark scores detached from everyday work. Inference: Combining optimization using megakernel, 4-bit quantization, and DFly techniques, Hy4 flash achieves decoding speeds exceeding 150 tokens per second, enabling low-cost deployment at scale. As a result, Hy4 flash slightly outperforms the larger Hy4 Preview (770 billion total parameters, 49 billion active parameters) in overall effectiveness, at a significantly lower cost. Based on the internal WorkIndex benchmark, which covers PowerPoint deck creation and editing, document editing, spreadsheet repair, audio/video processing, and visual understanding tasks typical of use with WorkBuddy — Hy4 flash delivers a per-task cost of just 1/13 that of Hy4 Preview, 1/20 that of Hy4, and 1/8 that of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Max tier, peak-hour pricing). Additionally, in a blind evaluation with 85 internal Tencent WorkBuddy users across 259 tasks in 27 categories, Hy4 flash achieved user satisfaction close to Claude Haiku 5.5, with the significantly lower per-task cost among all models evaluated and the shortest task completion time. Hy4 flash is now available across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom, QQ, ima, and Marvis, with OpenRouter integration coming soon. BARCELONA, Spain, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Woolpert has acquired B-Global Tech, a Barcelona-based architecture and engineering firm specializing in the design and delivery of digital infrastructure projects across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. The acquisition expands Woolpert's data center expertise and strengthens its ability to support complex data centers and mission critical facilities across the globe. Founded in 2001, B-Global Tech has more than 200 architects, MEP engineers, project managers, BIM specialists, and technical advisors across Spain and Southeast Asia, including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Japan. With the addition of B-Global Tech, Woolpert now has more than 1,200 professionals focused on the responsible design of data center infrastructure worldwide. As data and compute requirements continue to grow, along with expectations for responsible development, data center programs are becoming more complex and specialized. B-Global Tech adds significant technical depth to Woolpert's global mission critical practice, strengthening its ability to deliver data center programs that meet industry needs while considering and mitigating impacts on local communities. The acquisition also brings together complementary expertise in AI infrastructure. Woolpert has designed some of the largest hyperscale and AI data centers in the U.S. and Australia, including gigawatt-scale campuses. B-Global Tech brings additional expertise in direct liquid cooling and AI data centers across Europe and Asia-Pacific, including designing the facility for one of the European Union's flagship supercomputers, contributing to the EU AI gigafactory in Spain, and delivering the first NVIDIA data center in Asia-Pacific. "B-Global Tech brings exceptional data center expertise and an established presence in some of the world's most important digital infrastructure markets," Woolpert President and CEO Neil Churman said. "Together, we are building a truly global mission critical practice with the specialized expertise, multidisciplinary capabilities, and scale to help our clients deliver increasingly complex infrastructure with greater certainty while ensuring these facilities are designed and developed responsibly and in line with local requirements." The move builds on Woolpert's continued expansion of its advanced and technically complex architecture and engineering capabilities. Following successful partnerships with SNHA, Vela Tech, and UMC Architects in the U.S. and Europe and Greenbox Architecture in the Asia-Pacific region, B-Global Tech adds further depth and geographic reach to Woolpert's global practice. "This is an exciting opportunity to build on what our people have created at B-Global Tech while expanding the opportunities available to our teams and clients," B-Global Tech Co-Founder Lluis Gironella Ferrer said. "Joining Woolpert connects our people to a global network of expertise and resources, creating new opportunities to collaborate across markets and giving clients a premier architecture and engineering design firm they can trust to support their AI data center needs worldwide." Together, B-Global Tech and Woolpert will provide a broader network of technical specialists to clients and programs around the world, with capabilities spanning multidisciplinary design, infrastructure, geospatial, MEP and specialized systems, commissioning, and operational readiness. About Woolpert Woolpert helps organizations shape what matters by connecting physical infrastructure and digital intelligence. For more than a century, we've helped many of the world's leading governments, businesses, and institutions understand, design, build, and manage the critical systems, assets, and environments people rely on every day. Combining architecture, engineering, geospatial, advisory, and technology expertise, we turn complex challenges into smarter decisions, stronger performance, and lasting impact. bd.title: Tencent Launches Hy4 flash to Power High-Speed, Cost-Efficient AI Deployment for Everyday Workflows
bd.description: SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tencent today announced the release of Hy4 flash, the latest addition to its Hy model family. Hy4 flash has 224 billion total parameters (including 64 billion Engram parameters) with only 12 billion active parameters, and supports multimodal inputs and a context length of up to 1M tokens. It is the most cost-effective Hy model to date, priced at approximately US$0.070 per million input tokens, US$0.281 per million output tokens, and US$0.003 per million cached input tokens — a substantial reduction from Hy4. Tencent To achieve this level of cost performance while maintaining strong intelligence and practical utility, the Tencent Hy team made a series of engineering choices across the model pipeline: Pre-training: Hy4 flash incorporates hybrid attention, LatentMoE, and Engram architectural features. The KV cache size is just 1/24 that of Hy3 and 1/6 that of Hy4. Extensive scaling ladder experiments were conducted to ensure performance met expectations. Post-training: Drawing directly from Hy4's architecture, the model inherits strong general intelligence. Reinforcement learning cuts average end-to-end task output tokens by 50 percent. Evaluation: The team built WorkIndex, an internal benchmark based on typical WorkBuddy tasks, paired with human evaluations, focusing on deliverable quality, single-turn output length, and task turnaround time rather than public benchmark scores detached from everyday work. Inference: Combining optimization using megakernel, 4-bit quantization, and DFly techniques, Hy4 flash achieves decoding speeds exceeding 150 tokens per second, enabling low-cost deployment at scale. As a result, Hy4 flash slightly outperforms the larger Hy4 Preview (770 billion total parameters, 49 billion active parameters) in overall effectiveness, at a significantly lower cost. Based on the internal WorkIndex benchmark, which covers PowerPoint deck creation and editing, document editing, spreadsheet repair, audio/video processing, and visual understanding tasks typical of use with WorkBuddy — Hy4 flash delivers a per-task cost of just 1/13 that of Hy4 Preview, 1/20 that of Hy4, and 1/8 that of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Max tier, peak-hour pricing). Additionally, in a blind evaluation with 85 internal Tencent WorkBuddy users across 259 tasks in 27 categories, Hy4 flash achieved user satisfaction close to Claude Haiku 5.5, with the significantly lower per-task cost among all models evaluated and the shortest task completion time. Hy4 flash is now available across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom, QQ, ima, and Marvis, with OpenRouter integration coming soon. From now till November 30, users can access Hy4 flash for free on WorkBuddy, and get 50 percent off standard pricing via Tencent Cloud TokenHub. Guided by a core commitment to practical AI, Tencent Hy continues to push the boundaries of intelligence while delivering exceptional cost performance. Hy4, released on November 4, joined the ranks of the world's leading open-source AI models, ranking second among Chinese models on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and first among open-source models on the Agent Arena leaderboard. With Hy4 flash, Tencent Hy achieves a stronger balance of intelligence and efficiency for real-world productivity tasks. The team recommends Hy4 flash for most everyday tasks, including deep research, document processing, PowerPoint deck generation, simple front-end displays, and computer use, while directing users to the more capable Hy4 for complex tasks such as long-horizon software engineering. Tencent Hy also plans to open-source Hy4 flash with frequent iterations to continuously improve its practical utility and efficiency for real-world work. bd.title: CP Group's Makro Completes Southeast Asia's First Large-Scale Complex Data Platform Consolidation with Tencent Cloud
bd.description: Unified data infrastructure streamlines operations, strengthens governance, and supports future AI innovation BANGKOK, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tencent Cloud and Makro, the wholesale business under CP AXTRA, have completed a major data platform consolidation project with Tencent Cloud. As part of the initiative, Makro successfully consolidated data infrastructure previously distributed across multiple platforms onto Tencent Cloud, creating a unified foundation for its enterprise data assets. The migration was completed with uninterrupted business operations and zero data discrepancies, marking a benchmark of Southeast Asia's large-scale complex data platform consolidation projects. Makro, operated by CP AXTRA Public Company Limited (CP AXTRA), part of CP Group, is one of Thailand's largest wholesale and retail brands. Its Makro PRO application has been recognized as Thailand's leading Thai-owned, first-party (1P) e-commerce platform. With continued growth in digital business operations and expansion into ASEAN markets, Makro has experienced rapid increases in transaction, product, and membership data. As transaction, product, and membership data continued to grow, Makro's existing data development, analytics, scheduling, and governance environments, which spanned more than 10 products from multiple vendors, required modernization and consolidation to support future growth. Modernizing enterprise data platforms is widely regarded as one of the most complex initiatives in digital transformation. Large-scale data environments support hundreds of business processes, applications, and workflows, requiring organizations to maintain operational continuity and data consistency throughout the migration process. To support Makro's modernization objectives, Tencent Cloud consolidated critical data capabilities onto two core platforms: Tencent Cloud Data Lake Compute (DLC), its serverless data lake analytics service, and WeData, Tencent Cloud's intelligent platform for data integration, development, orchestration, and governance. By unifying previously fragmented workflows under a single architecture, Makro has streamlined data operations and established a scalable foundation for future innovation. Leveraging Tencent Cloud's integrated data and AI capabilities, Makro has further unified data engineering, analytics, and AI workflows. The same data assets can now support both operational decision-making and AI model development, reducing cross-system complexity while laying the groundwork for future AI-powered initiatives such as warehouse forecasting and inventory optimization. The transformation has improved downstream operational efficiency by more than 25%, while helping over 20 business units, including supply chain, finance, and other core functions, complete their data and analytics modernization journey. Tencent Cloud also helped Makro strengthen its data governance framework by standardizing the end-to-end management of data assets, from ingestion and processing to business consumption. Data tables, fields, and relationships are now centrally managed, enabling full traceability of data origins, transformation processes, and downstream usage. Today, nearly 10,000 production tasks are executed daily on Tencent Cloud's big data platform. For the first time, Makro has also achieved unified visibility and management of enterprise-wide data assets through a single platform. Tencent Cloud also leveraged AI to accelerate code adaptation and data validation during the migration. Powered by CodeBuddy, Tencent Cloud's AI-assisted coding solution, the project team was able to automatically analyze business SQL scripts, perform code conversion, and validate data consistency at scale. When discrepancies were detected, the system generated detailed reports to help engineers quickly identify and resolve issues. As a result, validation of a single data table, which previously took one to two hours, can now be completed in approximately five minutes. Beyond the data platform transformation, Tencent Cloud provides Makro with cloud infrastructure and services spanning containers, databases, and Tencent Cloud EdgeOne. Today, the collaboration spans multiple layers of Makro's technology stack, from foundational cloud infrastructure to mission-critical data platforms, supporting the company's ongoing digital transformation journey. Tanit Chearavanont, Group Chief Wholesale Business Officer, CP AXTRA, said: "Data is increasingly critical to driving innovation, operational excellence, and long-term growth in the wholesale and retail industry. Tencent Cloud has demonstrated strong technical expertise and a deep understanding of our business needs throughout this transformation journey. We look forward to further strengthening our collaboration to unlock greater value from our data assets and accelerate future AI-driven innovation." Poshu Yeung, Senior Vice President of Tencent Cloud and Head of Tencent Cloud International, said: "Large-scale data platform modernization presents significant challenges around workload migration, business continuity, and data consistency. We are proud to support Makro in completing this landmark transformation, which demonstrates how enterprises can consolidate complex data environments while maintaining operational stability. As organizations across Southeast Asia continue to accelerate digital transformation, we look forward to helping more businesses build modern data foundations that enable innovation and AI adoption at scale." The collaboration with Makro highlights Tencent Cloud's growing capabilities in supporting large-scale enterprise data modernization initiatives across international markets. By helping organizations unify data infrastructure, strengthen governance, and build AI-ready foundations, Tencent Cloud continues to support businesses across industries as they accelerate digital transformation. pk.title: Tencent Launches Hy4 flash to Power High-Speed, Cost-Efficient AI Deployment for Everyday Workflows
pk.description: SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Tencent today announced the release of Hy4 flash, the latest addition to its Hy model family. Hy4 flash has 224 billion total parameters (including 64 billion Engram parameters) with only 12 billion active parameters, and supports multimodal inputs and a context length of up to 1M tokens. It is the most cost-effective Hy model to date, priced at approximately US$0.070 per million input tokens, US$0.281 per million output tokens, and US$0.003 per million cached input tokens — a substantial reduction from Hy4. Tencent To achieve this level of cost performance while maintaining strong intelligence and practical utility, the Tencent Hy team made a series of engineering choices across the model pipeline: Pre-training: Hy4 flash incorporates hybrid attention, LatentMoE, and Engram architectural features. The KV cache size is just 1/24 that of Hy3 and 1/6 that of Hy4. Extensive scaling ladder experiments were conducted to ensure performance met expectations. Post-training: Drawing directly from Hy4's architecture, the model inherits strong general intelligence. Reinforcement learning cuts average end-to-end task output tokens by 50 percent. Evaluation: The team built WorkIndex, an internal benchmark based on typical WorkBuddy tasks, paired with human evaluations, focusing on deliverable quality, single-turn output length, and task turnaround time rather than public benchmark scores detached from everyday work. Inference: Combining optimization using megakernel, 4-bit quantization, and DFly techniques, Hy4 flash achieves decoding speeds exceeding 150 tokens per second, enabling low-cost deployment at scale. As a result, Hy4 flash slightly outperforms the larger Hy4 Preview (770 billion total parameters, 49 billion active parameters) in overall effectiveness, at a significantly lower cost. Based on the internal WorkIndex benchmark, which covers PowerPoint deck creation and editing, document editing, spreadsheet repair, audio/video processing, and visual understanding tasks typical of use with WorkBuddy — Hy4 flash delivers a per-task cost of just 1/13 that of Hy4 Preview, 1/20 that of Hy4, and 1/8 that of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Max tier, peak-hour pricing). Additionally, in a blind evaluation with 85 internal Tencent WorkBuddy users across 259 tasks in 27 categories, Hy4 flash achieved user satisfaction close to Claude Haiku 5.5, with the significantly lower per-task cost among all models evaluated and the shortest task completion time. Hy4 flash is now available across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, WorkBuddy, Yuanbao, WeCom, QQ, ima, and Marvis, with OpenRouter integration coming soon. From now till November 30, users can access Hy4 flash for free on WorkBuddy, and get 50 percent off standard pricing via Tencent Cloud TokenHub. Guided by a core commitment to practical AI, Tencent Hy continues to push the boundaries of intelligence while delivering exceptional cost performance. Hy4, released on November 4, joined the ranks of the world's leading open-source AI models, ranking second among Chinese models on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and first among open-source models on the Agent Arena leaderboard. With Hy4 flash, Tencent Hy achieves a stronger balance of intelligence and efficiency for real-world productivity tasks. The team recommends Hy4 flash for most everyday tasks, including deep research, document processing, PowerPoint deck generation, simple front-end displays, and computer use, while directing users to the more capable Hy4 for complex tasks such as long-horizon software engineering. BARCELONA, Spain, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Woolpert has acquired B-Global Tech, a Barcelona-based architecture and engineering firm specializing in the design and delivery of digital infrastructure projects across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. The acquisition expands Woolpert's data center expertise and strengthens its ability to support complex data centers and mission critical facilities across the globe. Founded in 2001, B-Global Tech has more than 200 architects, MEP engineers, project managers, BIM specialists, and technical advisors across Spain and Southeast Asia, including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Japan. ae.title: ROBOTERA Expands Humanoid Robot Deployment Across China Post's Guangdong Network, Reaching Eight Cities Province-Wide
ae.description: BEIJING, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ROBOTERA has deployed its humanoid robots across China Post Group Guangdong Branch's network, reaching 11 postal hubs in 8 cities across Guangdong Province. This marks the largest-scale and most geographically extensive deployment of embodied intelligence robots in the logistics sector to date. Spanning Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Dongguan, Jiangmen, Shantou, Shanwei, Jieyang and Heyuan, the rollout translates embodied intelligence into new industrial productivity, accelerating the intelligent transformation of postal and logistics operations. ROBOTERA humanoid robots deployed across China Post’s Guangdong postal network, covering 11 hubs in 8 cities across the province. The project is jointly implemented by China Post Group Guangdong Branch and Beijing Xingdongjiyuan Technology Co., Ltd. (ROBOTERA). Guangdong is China's largest province by express parcel volume, making its postal network a demanding real-world environment for validating robotics at scale. The deployment covers varied operating conditions, including high-volume sorting and cross-regional logistics coordination. Logistics sorting is labor-intensive, involving repetitive physical work under harsh working conditions. Persistent labor shortages and high workforce turnover add to the pressure, especially during peak shopping seasons, when parcel volumes can surge to several times their normal levels. ROBOTERA's humanoid robots help fill capacity gaps by taking on strenuous frontline tasks, supporting stable operations during demand peaks while allowing human workers to focus on higher-value roles such as robot maintenance, operations coordination and quality control. Since the pilot began at the Guangzhou Postal District Center in March 2026, ROBOTERA's robots have achieved an average induction rate of more than 1,500 parcels per hour, comparable to the performance of experienced human workers. This demonstrates their ability to handle high-throughput sorting tasks in demanding, real-world logistics operations. Beyond Guangdong, ROBOTERA's integrated solution has also been deployed across postal operations in East China, adapting to different operating environments, parcel types and sorting-line configurations. Its capabilities include irregular-item rejection and adaptive speed control to reduce jams, collisions and missed items. The solution also incorporates ROBOTERA's self-developed five-finger dexterous hand for flexible parcel handling, with multiple power options to accommodate different site requirements and support continuous operation. ROBOTERA develops general-purpose robots through an AI-native, full-stack in-house technology approach spanning data, motion control, foundation models, dexterous hands and humanoid systems. The company continues to work with logistics operators and industry partners to bring embodied intelligence into more real-world workflows and help build a new engine for industrial productivity.

sa.title: تقرير أممي : الحوثيون يستغلون شبكة الاتصالات للتجسس وتمويل الحرب
sa.description: لم تعد شبكات الاتصالات في اليمن مجرد وسيلة للتواصل بين المواطنين، بعدما حولتها مليشيا الحوثي إلى منظومة متعددة الاستخدامات، تجمع بين جباية الأموال وتمويل العمليات العسكرية ومراقبة المستخدمين والتضييق على تدفق المعلومات، مستفيدة من سيطرتها الواسعة على البنية التحتية للقطاع وشركاته ومؤسساته. وكشف التقرير النهائي لفريق خبراء الأمم المتحدة المعني باليمن، الصادر في أكتوبر 2025، أن الحوثيين يفرضون سيطرة كاملة على قطاع الاتصالات، الذي يدر إيرادات كبيرة يذهب جزء منها لتمويل أنشطتهم العسكرية، في إطار شبكة اقتصادية تستغل المؤسسات المدنية ومقدرات الدولة لخدمة المجهود الحربي. مليارات من جيوب المشتركين ووفق التقرير الأممي، تتجاوز الإيرادات المقدرة لقطاع الاتصالات العام والخاص 150 مليار ريال يمني، أي نحو 92 مليون دولار، فيما تقدر عائدات المكالمات الدولية الواردة إلى اليمن، التي تحصل عليها شركات الاتصالات الخاضعة لسيطرة الحوثيين، بنحو 20 مليون دولار شهرياً. ولا تقتصر عملية الاستغلال على العائدات التشغيلية، إذ رصد التقرير استمرار استخدام الرسائل النصية لحشد التبرعات، بعدما اطلع الفريق على رسائل تطلب من المشتركين تقديم مساهمات بقيمة 100 ريال لصالح القوة الصاروخية وسلاح الطيران المسيّر، إلى جانب منشورات تروّج لهذه الحملات عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. من الاتصالات إلى التجسس أما الجانب الأكثر خطورة فيتمثل في تحويل البنية التحتية للاتصالات إلى أداة للرقابة وجمع المعلومات. فقد تناولت تقارير سابقة لفريق الخبراء الأممي مخاوف من استغلال السيطرة على النطاق الوطني اليمني وأنظمة إدارة سعة الإنترنت في صنعاء لمراقبة المستخدمين والتحكم في حركة الاتصالات وحجب المواقع والمحتوى. وتمنح السيطرة على شبكات الهاتف والإنترنت إمكانات واسعة للوصول إلى بيانات المستخدمين الوصفية، مثل سجلات المكالمات وأوقات الاتصال وبيانات أبراج الشبكات، وهي معلومات يمكن أن تكشف أنماط الحركة والارتباطات بين الأشخاص، وتوفر معطيات حساسة عن الشخصيات العسكرية والمدنية. كما حذرت تقارير وتحقيقات يمنية من توظيف هذه الإمكانات في تعقب المعارضين ورصد تحركات الخصوم، فضلاً عن استخدام الاتصالات في التضييق الإعلامي والتحكم في تدفق المعلومات. اقتصاد حرب ورقابة ويعكس هذا الواقع توظيف الحوثيين قطاعاً خدمياً حيوياً في بناء اقتصاد حرب، لا تقتصر موارده على الضرائب والجبايات، بل تمتد إلى عائدات المكالمات الدولية والإنترنت والتبرعات الإجبارية أو المستحثة عبر الرسائل. وبينما يدفع اليمنيون تكاليف خدمات الاتصالات من دخولهم المحدودة، تتزايد المخاوف من أن تتحول بياناتهم الشخصية وخصوصيتهم إلى مورد إضافي في يد المليشيا، في وقت تتراجع فيه استقلالية المؤسسات الرقابية وتتعطل الضمانات اللازمة لحماية المستخدمين.

iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد افتتحت وزارة الشباب والرياضة العراقية، يوم الثلاثاء، معرض الوظائف 2026 بالتعاون مع الوكالة الألمانية للتعاون الدولي، بمشاركة أكثر من 70 شركة ومؤسسة تطرح ما يزيد على ألفي فرصة عمل، فيما دعا وزير الشباب والرياضة صفاء الكناني إلى تبني رؤية جديدة للتعامل مع ملف التوظيف والتعيينات. ويستمر المعرض أربعة أيام، ويتيح للشباب التقديم المباشر على الوظائف من خلال تقديم سيرهم الذاتية وإجراء المقابلات مع الشركات والمؤسسات المشاركة. وقال الكناني، خلال افتتاح المعرض الذي حضرته وكالة شفق نيوز، إن "الحديث عن فرص العمل هو حديث عن طاقات الشباب وطموحاتهم، وأخطر ما يمكن أن نفعله هو إقناعهم بأن أحلامهم أكبر من الفرص المتاحة"، مشددا على ضرورة فتح الأبواب أمام الشباب وتمكينهم من دخول سوق العمل. وأضاف أن "الوزارة لا تريد لهذا المعرض أن يكون مناسبة لتبادل الكلمات، وإنما نقطة انطلاق لشراكة حقيقية مع القطاع الخاص"، مبيناً أن الوزارة عقدت لقاءات مع الشركات واستمعت إلى احتياجاتها قبل تنظيم المعرض. وأوضح الكناني، أن المعرض يهدف إلى تعريف الشباب بطبيعة سوق العمل واحتياجاته، وإتاحة الفرصة لهم للاطلاع مباشرة على متطلبات الشركات والمؤسسات، فضلاً عن تطوير أساليب العمل من خلال الاستماع إلى الشباب والاستفادة من التجارب الناجحة. وخلص إلى أن الوزارة ملتزمة بمراجعة آليات عملها بصورة دورية، بما يسهم في توسيع فرص الشباب وتعزيز مهاراتهم وقدراتهم المهنية، مؤكدا أن "الحكومة القوية لا تجعل الشاب بارعاً في متابعة المعاملات وإجراءاتها، بل بارعاً في الإنجاز والمهارة.

cm.title: Douane : le renseignement géospatial au centre des échanges à Yaoundé
cm.description: © DR Sous la présidence de FONGOD Edwin Nuvaga, Directeur général des Douanes du Cameroun, Yaoundé accueille du 16 au 20 novembre 2026 le 3e atelier OMD-JICA des maîtres formateurs en renseignement géospatial, étape décisive pour moderniser la lutte contre la criminalité transfrontalière en Afrique. Yaoundé devient, une semaine durant, la capitale africaine du renseignement douanier. Lundi 16 novembre, Edwin Nuvaga a ouvert les travaux du 3e atelier GEOINT, fruit de la coopération stratégique entre l'Organisation mondiale des Douanes et l'Agence japonaise de coopération internationale. Après Nairobi en février et Dakar en mai, le Cameroun accueille 28 participants venus de 14 pays, encadrés par 8 experts venus des États-Unis, de France, du Japon, d'Ouzbékistan et des Pays-Bas. Le Cameroun est représenté par le capitaine Hugues Amba Bontsebe et l'adjudant principal Caeli Ami Ndula. À la tribune, Massaya Deguchi a rappelé la genèse du projet : face à des réseaux criminels qui exploitent les frontières poreuses, doter les douanes d'imagerie satellitaire et d'analyse spatiale pour anticiper les trafics. Okumoto Masakatsu, de la JICA, a réaffirmé l'engagement du Japon pour la digitalisation des douanes africaines. Dans son allocution, Fongod Edwin Nuvaga a assumé un changement de paradigme : la mission sécuritaire des douanes devient aussi impérative que la mission fiscale, face au terrorisme et à la criminalité organisée. Aux futurs formateurs, il a lancé un appel à la responsabilité : devenir les relais et les artisans de cette expertise dans leurs administrations. Les travaux s'achèveront vendredi par une feuille de route pour intégrer durablement le GEOINT dans les stratégies nationales de sécurité frontalière. Cet article Douane : le renseignement géospatial au centre des échanges à Yaoundé est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com.
